Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the call today. Good discussion; Parallax is excited by the performance and the routing/fallback capabilities you showed. Our engineering and security teams want a focused runthrough so they can validate latency, throughput and data controls before we progress to procurement.

Goal: 60–90 minute technical runthrough covering: serving topology, caching/kv behavior, quantization tradeoffs for our 7B model, and the data residency/audit log story. We also need to confirm throughput numbers for 100RPS sustained with 512 token avg responses.

Availability: our engineers are on Pacific time. Best windows next week are Mon/Tue after 1pm PT or Wed morning before 11am PT. Can you propose 2 concrete slots and the internal attendee list you recommend? We want Redwood infra + a solutions engineer + your security PM on the call.

Also attaching an internal checklist we use (see referenced attachment stub) — will forward any SOC2 artifact requests after we calendar the session.
